independence_declaration.statement:
release-auditor authored no DG5 implementation, test, register row, ADR, repair, salvage, delivery decision or finding fix. That includes waves V1 to AB2, the WIP salvages, D-141 to D-183 and the round-7 freeze. qa-verifier appears among the authors only for its pre-freeze acceptance tests (T-DG5-QA-A..F2, tests/qa and e2e only; 03/04 logs), which the protocol allows. The five DG5 rows it co-owns (REQ-S20-002, 006, 007, 015, 016) are also covered independently by domain-reviewer. devops-engineer is listed as a register co-owner, as in domain's record.

I audited the frozen candidate directly in a complete disposable clone, $TMPDIR/c (git clone --no-local --no-checkout, not a worktree; not shallow; fsck connectivity clean; 171 refs), with a sparse checkout of the gate tooling. A first plain clone filled the scratch volume. I deleted only my own clone and disclosed it (01 log). No other agent's files or scratch were touched.

The three specialist runs had ended before my run started. My only writes are this record, its verifications sidecar and evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/audit/round-8/. I did not write docs/delivery/gates/DG5.json (assignment: the round-9 decision run does). All product data cited is SYNTHETIC.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the assignment hash. Make a complete git clone (not a worktree) under $TMPDIR and check it is not shallow and fsck-clean. Recompute the candidate with --ref 12dc33e in the clone and in the repository, and on the repository working tree. Diff the frozen manifest against the working tree, and list what changed between 12dc33e and HEAD. Validate DG4 historically and the DG5 register.
checks_run.command: sha256sum <assignment>; git clone --no-local --no-checkout /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/c; git sparse-checkout set --no-cone /tools/ ...; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG5 [--ref 12dc33e4f9f2f804aeb0a9774a988d699709a235 | --diff]; git diff --name-only 12dc33e HEAD; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG4; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG5
checks_run.environment: repository HEAD 792e693; complete clone $TMPDIR/c (HEAD 792e693); node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: Assignment sha256 a088558b…390. The clone is complete. --ref gives sha256:33188e9e…7c47 with 2194 files in the clone and the repository. Post-freeze changes are meta-excluded, apart from the D-183 row in decisions.md. DG4 historical and DG5 register PASS.
checks_run.actual:
The assignment hash matches. The clone is not shallow; fsck --connectivity-only shows no non-dangling problem; 171 refs; 12dc33e is present and an ancestor of HEAD.

candidate.mjs --ref 12dc33e gives sha256:33188e9e698fd11bb80cc95c3ccb865f24f83df1451f7c46788ec9b1e51c7f47, 2194 files, exit 0, in the clone and in the repository. This equals the manifest (source 12dc33e, frozen_at 2026-10-22T22:09:41Z, 2194 entries) and stages.json.

The repository working tree gives sha256:15628ce4…, and --diff (exit 1) names exactly one changed file, docs/delivery/decisions.md. 12dc33e..HEAD changes assignments, the manifest, findings.json, stages.json, reviews, runs and test evidence (all meta-excluded) plus decisions.md, whose diff is exactly 1 inserted line, the D-183 row (d7831c1). The validator computes the candidate from the source commit, so the reviewed candidate is unaffected. Confirmed.

--historical --stage DG4: 'PASS gate DG4 (historical)', exit 0 (DG4 APPROVED on f38274cb). --register DG5: 'PASS register rules at DG5', exit 0. --pipeline: PASS, exit 0.

Disclosed: my first plain clone filled the scratch volume (exit 1, MODULE_NOT_FOUND in a half-checked-out tree). I removed only my own clone.

checks_run.procedure: For each cited specialist record (domain R7C, code-security R7, qa R8, plus qa R7C as qa's full review), resolve invocation_reference to runs/DG5/<run_id>/meta.json. Check role, task, session, exit code, subtype, bash and process sandbox, sha256(sandbox.json) = process_sandbox_sha256, transcript and result hashes, the record in tool_authored, the assignment hash, external_config_changed and process_sandbox_discarded. Check distinct sessions. Scan every DG5 review run for external_config_changed. Check that qa's pre-freeze authoring runs wrote only tests/qa, e2e and their own evidence, and that no reviewer role has an implementation run.
checks_run.command: node scripts/prov.mjs; node -e <write-scope scan of runs/DG5/DG5-T-DG5-QA-*>; ls docs/delivery/runs/DG5
checks_run.expected: Four distinct, successful, sandboxed runs bound to their records. No D-082 change in any DG5 review run. No reviewer implemented DG5 scope.

checks_run.procedure: Read the cited records' candidate, source, verdict, check results and findings. Judge whether qa's round-8 acceptance record, citing its round-7 evidence, together with domain's and code-security's round-7 records, is a sound basis for the gate.
checks_run.command: node -e <summary of the four records>; stages.json review_rounds
checks_run.expected: Three PASS verdicts on 33188e9e, with no BLOCKED or FAIL check.

checks_run.procedure: Read every DG5 finding in findings.json. Check terminal status, severity, mandatory flag, owner vs verifier, and fix_revision (full, a commit, an ancestor of 12dc33e). Then run the validator's own checkFindings and checkReviewRounds (tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs, read-only) against the repository. Use a hypothetical gate object at the candidate source that lists F-DG5-125/150/151 as accepted observations. This is needed because validate.mjs --stage DG5 stops at the missing gate record and never reaches these rules.
checks_run.command: node scripts/find.mjs; node scripts/chkfind.mjs; git log -- docs/delivery/findings.json (fix_revision count per commit); git log -- docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-4/code-security-reviewer.verifications.json
checks_run.expected: Every DG5 finding terminal: CLOSED_VERIFIED by a non-owner with an ancestor fix_revision, or ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION (Low, non-mandatory). 0 unresolved Critical/High or mandatory findings. Validator rules raise only the expected pre-import and pre-gate items.
checks_run.actual:
21 DG5 findings: 18 CLOSED_VERIFIED (10 Medium, 3 of them mandatory: F-DG5-100, 101, 124; 8 Low) and 3 ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION (F-DG5-125, 150, 151; Low, not mandatory). No Critical/High. Every closure's verification.by_role differs from its owner.

FAILED:
(a) None of the 18 CLOSED_VERIFIED DG5 findings has a fix_revision (or fix_summary). None ever passed through FIXED_PENDING_VERIFICATION: across all 8 DG5 commits of findings.json the count is 0 (DG4 has 25 such entries). import-findings.mjs --fix was never run in DG5. The validator rejects each one: 'CLOSED_VERIFIED needs a full fix_revision commit id' (rules.mjs:742). The fixes themselves appear to be in the candidate: the sampled merges 1608c29, a5900c0, d2f4579, d3bcb4a, 45287b4, ff5f561 and c71d166 are ancestors of 12dc33e. The defect is the missing anchored record, which the gate requires.
(b) The domain records of round 3 and round 4 are not valid review records: source_commit 'bbd6294' and 'fb9c221' (short), against the pattern ^[0-9a-f]{40}$. Their sidecars therefore cannot be used. F-DG5-122 (round 3) and F-DG5-123 (round 4) get 'CLOSED_VERIFIED but no reviewer verifications sidecar verifies it'. For F-DG5-120 the latest usable verification is round 2's FAIL/OPEN, so findings.json's CLOSED_VERIFIED contradicts it (5 errors). checkReviewRounds also reports both records as schema-invalid.
(c) Write-once: reviews/DG5/round-4/code-security-reviewer.verifications.json was committed by the stopped SEC-R4 run (c3c964e), deleted in the D-176 salvage b6c03d7, and committed again with different content by SEC-R4C (05305ba). The validator gives 'has a D event in b6c03d7d6b' and 'committed with 2 different contents (review evidence is append-only)'. D-176 records the salvage but not this consequence. It cannot be undone without rewriting history, which needs a user decision (D-136 precedent).

Expected, not blocking: F-DG5-125/150/151 'no release-auditor sidecar accepts it' and 'accepted_by does not mirror' (my sidecar is written in this run and not yet imported), and 'round 8 release-auditor: file not found' (this run's own record).

checks_run.procedure: Judge F-DG5-125, F-DG5-150 and F-DG5-151 myself: inspect the source at 12dc33e and at the DG4 source e70ac02, read the product e2e, spot-check the cited measurement and probe evidence, and confirm severity, mandatory status and each requirement's final gate.
checks_run.command: git show 12dc33e:apps/web/src/api/queries.ts; git grep useReadableTransformations 12dc33e / e70ac02; git show 12dc33e:apps/web/src/pages/traceability/TraceabilityPage.tsx; git diff e70ac02 12dc33e -- TraceabilityPage.tsx; git show 12dc33e:apps/web/e2e/p5-launch-health-kpi.spec.ts; head <qa probe JSON/JSONL>
checks_run.expected: Each finding is reproduced or confirmed in source, is Low and non-mandatory, has no DG5 acceptance impact, and gets a DG6 carry-forward with an owner.
checks_run.actual:
F-DG5-125: confirmed. fetchAllPages stops silently after 20 pages of 100 and feeds both useReadableTransformations hooks and CompleteWithOutput.tsx:37. Both hooks used it already at e70ac02 (not a regression). Server totals are unaffected. REQ-S15-011 is DG6-final. Accepted, with a mandatory DG6 fix (D-181 class).

F-DG5-150: confirmed. The data-root note interpolates the name outside .record-name, and the e70ac02..12dc33e diff does not touch it. qa's JSON shows 0 px before Focus and 651/681/721 px after for a 120-character unbroken token. REQ-S15-009 is DG6-final. Accepted.

F-DG5-151: confirmed. The `reloaded` waiter is registered before the save click and matches any GET. qa's SLOWGET JSONL shows reloadedSeq 1 (version 26) vs PUT version 27, with the product still sending If-Match "27". Test-only. The D-182 cause stays unproven and is disclosed. Accepted.

All three: PASS, ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION in release-auditor.verifications.json, with rationale, DG6 follow-up and owner (frontend-ux-engineer).

checks_run.procedure: Check the recording of the DG5 interruptions (D-164 to D-183): orphaned runs and evidence folders; every 'WIP T-DG5-*' commit in 12dc33e's history and whether a successful continuation run started from a commit containing it; the D-176 sandbox setting and code-security's judgement of it; the D-181 picker defect; the D-182 failure against its own logs.
checks_run.command: ls runs/DG5 *-orphaned, test-evidence/DG5/*-orphaned; git log --grep='^WIP T-DG5' 12dc33e + merge-base --is-ancestor <WIP> <continuation head_commit_at_start>; cat orchestrator-D-182/verify-ab2-45287b4/*.rc; grep reviews/DG5/round-5/code-security-reviewer.json
checks_run.expected: Every incident recorded; no unverified WIP in the candidate without a successful continuation and a later merged-tree verification and review; D-176 judged; D-181 fixed; D-182 disclosed and judged.
checks_run.actual:
Orphaned run folders: FE-AB2, DOM-R7, DOM-R7B, QA-R7 and QA-R7B, each with a transcript and pre-snapshot and no meta (stopped mid-run). There are 30 '*-orphaned' evidence folders. All are recorded in D-147 to D-183.

All 16 WIP commits in 12dc33e's history were continued by an exit-0 'success' run whose head_commit_at_start contains the WIP:
- FE-Z1 d63afd4 → FE-Z1B, FE-Z1C;
- FE-AB2 69ac4f0 → FE-AB2B;
- also V1/V2B, D5, T5, O, KBE-D2, E2, P2, KBE-C2, Q, G, J, H2, B3.
After each came a merged-tree verification and full review rounds, so no unverified WIP reached the candidate unreviewed.

D-176 (allowNestedUserNamespaces, user-approved): code-security R5 SEC-R5-10 PASS. Statically, only the inner bwrap --disable-userns is dropped, while the outer process sandbox, cap-drop, no_new_privs and Landlock are unchanged. The dynamic nested-namespace test passed. The D-176 lesson (a tooling change during a round needs a re-freeze) was applied.

D-181: domain R7 confirmed the fix on all 12 pickers.

D-182: the logs match the decision exactly. e2e-unset.rc = 1 (459 passed, 1 failed: chromium-ar p5-launch-health-kpi.spec.ts:159); e2e-cutf8 460 passed; every other .rc is 0; repro-health 20 passed. It is not counted as passed. qa judged it in R7 (F-DG5-151) and I accept that judgement (AUD-R8-05).

checks_run.procedure: Check for any BLOCKED or unexplained check in the cited specialist records, and for documented environmental residuals.
checks_run.command: node -e <check result scan of the four records>
checks_run.expected: No unexplained BLOCKED check; environmental residuals listed as such.

checks_run.procedure: Compare the assignment's 78 IDs with requirements.csv final_gate=DG5. Check each is in qa R8's requirements_checked and in domain R7's or code-security R7's. Check register status. Run --register DG5.
checks_run.expected: 78 = 78; every ID covered by qa and by domain or code-security; register PASS.
checks_run.actual: The assignment list has 78 unique IDs, equal to the register's 78 final_gate=DG5 rows (0 difference each way). All 78 rows are IMPLEMENTED. Coverage: qa R8 78/78 (and qa R7 78/78), domain 78/78, code-security 42; 0 IDs lack qa plus domain or code-security. The qa-co-owned acceptance rows REQ-S20-002, 006, 007, 015 and 016 are all covered by domain. --register DG5: PASS, exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: Check that D-141 to D-183 exist with rationale. Quote their titles verbatim (09 log) and read D-176, D-177 and D-179 to D-183 in full. Inspect the orchestrator's own code edit d2f4579 and whether a review round covered it.
checks_run.command: node -e <extract D-141..D-183>; git show --stat d2f4579; grep -l d2f4579 reviews/DG5/round-*/*.json
checks_run.expected: 43 decisions with rationale; the orchestrator's edits reviewed; the D-176, D-180/D-181 and D-183 judgements sound.
checks_run.actual:
All 43 (D-141 to D-183) are present, none missing; bodies run from 928 to 7999 characters. Quoted titles include:
- D-179: 'Repair wave AA is integrated and verified; DG5 is re-frozen for review round 6.'
- D-180: 'DG5 round 6 on candidate `3294f8fc`: domain PASS, code-security PASS, qa PASS. Two new Low findings are fixed in wave AB, then round 7.'
- D-181: 'Wave AB's merged-tree verification found a pre-existing product defect: transformation pickers silently truncate.'
- D-182: 'Waves AB and AB2 are integrated and verified; DG5 is re-frozen for review round 7.'
- D-183: 'DG5 round 7 on candidate `33188e9e`: all three PASS; three new Low, non-mandatory findings; a short acceptance round 8 on the same candidate.'

Judgements:
- d2f4579 changes 2 files (app.css: a wrap rule on three title classes; openapi.yaml: one response description). It was before the round-6 freeze, and all three round-6 reviewers cite it. Acceptable.
- D-176: the user approved the setting, and code-security judged it in R5. Sound.
- D-180/D-181: fixing rather than accepting, and refusing to change the test that exposed a product defect, is the correct choice.
- D-183: an acceptance round on the unchanged candidate with independent acceptance by a specialist and the auditor follows the protocol. qa could refuse, and all three are carried to DG6. Sound.

One observation: D-179 names its verification logs as being in the orchestrator's scratchpad, but test-evidence/DG5/orchestrator-D-179/ exists in the repository. Not blocking.

checks_run.procedure: For each cited record, check that every evidence entry is an existing file. Grep every cited .log/.txt for non-zero exits, failed tests, ✘ and timeouts. For each real hit, find the record's disclosure and explanation.
checks_run.expected: 0 missing evidence; every non-zero exit, failure and timeout disclosed and explained.

checks_run.procedure: Grep the candidate source for DG references, PMI or official claims, and G6/DG7 coupling. Check the synthetic labelling of demo data and exports. Read the specialists' corresponding checks.
checks_run.command: git grep -E '\bDG[0-7]\b' 12dc33e -- apps packages; git grep -i 'PMI certified|official PMI' ...; git grep 'Illustrative example — synthetic'
checks_run.expected: Product gates are business approvals unrelated to DG0–DG7; no G6 → DG7 implication; no certification or official claims; demo data synthetic and labelled.
checks_run.actual: The only product-visible DG reference is gates.ts:995: 'Product gate (business approval inside the product); unrelated to the engineering delivery gates DG0-DG7.' Other matches are comments, migration headers and negative tests (problems-p5.test.ts: no P5 problem text names DG0–DG7; feg.test.tsx and route-editor.test.tsx refuse 'PMI standard/certified'; the text-scan corpus flags such claims). No G6/DG7 coupling. Demo exports carry 'Illustrative example — synthetic' / 'مثال توضيحي — اصطناعي' (forms/export.ts:96, integration-tested). Seed and demo modules mark data synthetic (266 matches). Domain DOM-R7-12 is PASS. Nothing grants a real business, Finance or IT approval.

checks_run.procedure: Run the stage validator and the pipeline, and classify every error as expected (missing gate record, my in-flight record, the three acceptances not yet imported) or blocking. Because validate.mjs stops at the missing gate record, use the AUD-R8-04 rule preview for the errors the round-9 decision run would meet.

summary:
Audit BLOCKED on candidate sha256:33188e9e698fd11bb80cc95c3ccb865f24f83df1451f7c46788ec9b1e51c7f47 (2194 files, source 12dc33e). The product review basis is sound. The DG5 findings record is not.

What holds:
- Identity: recomputed in a complete clone and in the repository; the only post-freeze candidate-file change is the D-183 row. DG4 validates historically, and the register and pipeline PASS.
- Provenance: three distinct, successful, sandboxed specialist runs with matching sandbox.json and no D-082 change in any DG5 review run.
- Verdicts: PASS on the same candidate. qa's round-8 acceptance round citing its round-7 review is a sound basis.
- Requirements: 78/78 covered (qa, plus domain or code-security).
- Incidents: all recorded; all 16 WIP salvages continued and verified.
- Decisions D-141 to D-183: present, with rationale.
- Evidence honesty and product/engineering-gate separation: hold.
- F-DG5-125, 150 and 151: independently accepted as observations, each with a DG6 carry-forward (owner frontend-ux-engineer).

Blocking conditions:
- B1. None of the 18 CLOSED_VERIFIED DG5 findings (F-DG5-100, 101, 102, 120 to 124, 140 to 149) has a fix_revision. None went through import-findings --fix / FIXED_PENDING_VERIFICATION. rules.mjs:742 rejects each, and assignment item 4 requires an ancestor fix_revision.
- B2. The closures of F-DG5-120 and F-DG5-122 (domain round 3) and F-DG5-123 (domain round 4) rest on schema-invalid review records (short source_commit 'bbd6294' and 'fb9c221'). F-DG5-120's latest usable verification is round 2's FAIL/OPEN.
- B3. checkReviewRounds rejects those two domain records.
- B4. A write-once breach: reviews/DG5/round-4/code-security-reviewer.verifications.json was deleted in the salvage commit b6c03d7 and re-committed with different content (05305ba).

B1 and B2 need fix revisions recorded and the affected closures re-verified by non-owner specialists in a valid round. B3 and B4 touch immutable history and need a user decision (D-056/D-136 precedent). The round-9 decision run must not write APPROVED until the validator's finding and review-round rules pass. I wrote no gate record.
